string-array.name: integration_call_mode_entries
string-array.item: Automatic: the system phone app when the calling account is enabled

resources.string: Calls run in the system phone app (its dialer, call screen and call log) when the account\'s calling account is enabled; otherwise in Linphone\'s call screen.
Every call runs in the system phone app. A calling account that is not enabled can\'t make or receive calls.
Calls run in Linphone\'s own call screen, as in the original app.
%1$s: not enabled - tap to enable it in Settings → Calls → Calling accounts
Granted: calls you start in Linphone run in the system phone app
Not granted - tap to allow. Without it, calls you start in Linphone use Linphone\'s call screen.
Calls from Linphone through the system
Calls you start in Linphone (contacts, history, dial pad) also run in the system phone app
Phone numbers in the system dialer
Offer the account for normal phone numbers (tel:), not only for SIP addresses. Needed for a gateway such as the MU300, which dials them through its modem.
The name the system shows for the calling account (in the dialer, the call screen and the call log). Empty: the SIP account\'s display name, or user@domain.
An incoming video call, or a video call you start, uses Linphone\'s call screen: the system call screen has no video
Mark calls with a wideband codec (Opus, G.722, AMR-WB …) as HD
Speaker, earpiece, Bluetooth or headset as chosen in the system call screen
The quick replies of the system\'s incoming call screen are sent to the caller as a chat message (through a gateway such as the MU300: as an SMS)
A rejected call answers 486 Busy Here (the caller hears busy) instead of 603 Decline
Send a ringing call to another number (SIP 302) from the system call screen
Blind and consultative transfer from the system call screen (SIP REFER)
Linphone call screen calls in the system call history
Android 17 and later: calls in Linphone\'s own call screen also go to the system\'s unified call history, with \"call back\". Calls in the system phone app are always there.
Turned off in the system - tap to change it
Tap to see the system\'s call log integration settings
Not available on this Android version
Calls dialled in the system dialer go over a SIP account instead of the SIM (emergency calls never do)

string-array.name: integration_redirect_mode_entries
string-array.item: Only numbers of contacts with a SIP address
Only on Wi-Fi (or on selected networks)

resources.string: Linphone is the call redirection app
Network names (SSIDs), separated by commas. Empty: any Wi-Fi. Reading the network name needs the location permission.
Granted: the Wi-Fi network name can be read
Needed only for selected Wi-Fi networks - tap to allow
Leave calls on the SIM while the SIP account is not registered (they would fail)
Numbers with fewer digits (short codes, operator services) stay on the SIM.
Prefixes, separated by commas (for example premium or service numbers: +420900, 900). Numbers starting with one stay on the SIM.
